second member of compound with lakṣya; describes the mantra repetition as counted to a set amount
prescriptive verbal form directing ritual recitation
object of japen; the sacred formula to be recited

items.question: By what measured manner must the mantra be repeated following the enclosure worship?
premises: The ritual sequence requires repetition of the mantra.
The repetition is specified as reaching a fixed number.
Additional related procedures are indicated by the concluding expression.
items.inference: After enclosure worship, the practitioner must repeat the mantra a prescribed number of times along with associated observances.
uncertainties: The exact numerical count implied by lakṣya-saṃkhyākaṃ is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should repeat the mantra a fixed number of times, and so forth.
